title: Switching failure for fixed coordinates
statement: Let $f:\{\pm1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $k$ be a natural number, let $J\subseteq\text{Fin}(n)$, and fix signs $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. The switching failure indicator of $f$ at threshold $k$ under the coordinate assignment that leaves $J$ free and fixes the other coordinates according to $z$ equals the switching failure indicator at threshold $k$ for the function obtained by fixing those outside coordinates to $z$.
hypotheses_covered: Sign assignment on the complement of $J$
